load-discipline: WDQS queried only by methods/fetch_wdqs.sh (explicit/polite/LIMIT<=800/one attempt); loop re-ingests committed snapshots with zero network I/O; national parks via five country-bound (cheap) fetches
process: methods/normalize_wdqs.cljc (raw *.raw.json in the data layer → committed snapshots; canonical unit map in code)
adr: ADR-2605241500 (datalad + git-annex → IPFS substrate); processed artifacts committed in 80-data (genome convention)

pin.how: e7m-dataset add 80-data/jinushi-land -> DataLad superdataset 90-docs/baien/datasets (git-annex -> IPFS CID map -> PDS datasetPin); not auto-run

coverage-policy: world coverage sums ONLY counts-toward-world-coverage sources; nature reserves overlap NP countries, observed-only — never summed (G2/G4); non-positive bad-data dropped

derived.what: canonical EAVT Datom log of the counting dataset (gitignored; regenerable via methods/emit_real.cljc)

cid-scheme: CIDv1 raw(0x55)/sha2-256, multibase base32 (bafkrei…) — single-block content hash; dag-pb/UnixFS parity is a future leg
verify: methods/verify.cljc re-derives each artifact CID+sha256 and checks against this file
